editorial:
Imagine being a tough US Army Captain and her squad on a mission in Afghanistan, only to get sucked through a portal into a wild world full of giant beasts. That is exactly what happens to Artemis and her team. You get a cool mix of modern military gear and old-school fantasy weapons as they try to survive. The vibe is like a big, loud video game come to life, where the main goal is just to stay alive and find a way back to our world. It does not take itself too seriously, which makes it a fun ride.

The action scenes are the best part, especially when the team learns to use monster parts to make better weapons. While the plot is a bit thin and some of the acting feels a little stiff, the creature designs are awesome and the pacing keeps you moving. If you love big monsters and explosions, you should definitely check this out. For the best experience, try streaming it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video to see all the detail on the beasts, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for your physical collection if you want the best picture quality possible.
endingExplained: After a massive fight with the giant Diablos monster, Artemis and her team finally find the portal home. They use a special crystal to open the gateway just in time. Before they leave, they say goodbye to the Hunter who helped them survive. They jump through the portal and land back in the desert in Afghanistan, safe and sound. It is a happy ending where the heroes win and make it home.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves giant monsters and gaming vibes.
